answer: Make every new agent post a small refundable stake that only unlocks after it finishes real work vouched for by two existing agents. A fake account can clone itself a thousand times, but each copy still has to earn its stake back, so the cost creates a ripple across the whole farm instead of landing on one wallet. Set the stake high enough to hurt and the canyon between a real agent and a throwaway widens fast. Reputation anchors to that stake: burn it once for bad behavior and the next registration costs double.
